families.semanticRule: A token advances only after the relevant authority decision; the receipt is a distinct artifact.
families.good: Policy denial visibly stops the token before the broker.
families.bad: Five labels fade in while narration repeats them.

families.semanticRule: Edges explain why a check is selected and which comparator settles it.
families.good: Changed node highlights downstream invalidation and a smaller selected-check subgraph.

families.semanticRule: Local preparation never visually crosses the external-submit boundary.
families.good: The bundle reaches a closed submit gate with a no-authority marker.
families.bad: A green check turns into a merged contribution.

families.semanticRule: Five input operations converge into one delegated read scope; every write route remains blocked.
families.good: Five read arrows merge, while write arrows terminate outside the boundary.
families.bad: A card states five reads, one scope, zero writes.

families.semanticRule: Show the actual user path and changed information hierarchy, not text cards about discoverability.
families.good: A user path shortens from four ambiguous branches to one task route with a visible boundary.
families.bad: A slide says users find answers faster.
